title: Tool versions of the organization
description: versions.json at the root of the hub: the version of each tool that the organization standardizes on and that the hub's nixpkgs revision doesn't pin. The versions check validates the file against this schema, and it fails when a workflow installs another version.

$schema.description: The path or address of this schema, for editors. The check doesn't read it.

nix.description: The version of Nix that the workflows install: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, as in the name of a release at releases.nixos.org. The hub installs this release through its setup-nix action, which reads this file, and a literal install_url elsewhere names the installer of this release (see docs/reference/setup-nix-action.md). The value holds no line break: the not keyword excludes the final newline that a pattern with $ accepts in some implementations.
